capabilities: Insert a zero-width space plus a real tab when Tab is pressed
Keep lines out of Markdown indented code blocks
Configure tab width via CSS tab-size
Work in both Source Mode and Live Preview
extras: The README warns that lines indented with this plugin are not recognized by Obsidian's built-in task features, task plugins (Tasks, Dataview), or search.
problem: Markdown treats leading whitespace as an indented code block, so pressing Tab to indent a line degrades the note instead of indenting it.
summary: Tab-key handler that inserts a zero-width space plus a real tab, giving true indentation without triggering Markdown indented code blocks.
